business_problem: Formez PA needed a way to standardize public-sector professional profiles, skills, and terminology so agencies could compare roles, exchange data, and collaborate without being blocked by incompatible dictionaries and manual profile entry.
solution_summary: Formez PA and IBM Client Engineering embedded AI into the RiVa portal to turn public-sector professional profiling into a semantic search and classification workflow. User descriptions are converted into embeddings with IBM watsonx.ai using the Llama model, while IBM watsonx.data—backed by Milvus as a vector database—executes semantic searches to find professional profiles that are conceptually similar even when keywords do not match. A custom microservice exposes APIs between the RiVa portal and the IBM services, and optional filters for contractual areas, professional dimensions, and professional families help narrow the result set. The solution can suggest profile names, organizational purposes, and primary activities from user descriptions and is designed to expand into skills and role recommendations over time. In practice, RiVa becomes a governed semantic layer for public-sector HR data rather than a static profile-entry form.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Runs semantic searches across vectorized professional profiles and skills data.

solution_components.name: Milvus
solution_components.role: Provides the vector database used to search for semantically similar professional profiles.

solution_components.name: IBM Code Engine
solution_components.role: Supports the microservice layer that exposes APIs between RiVa and the IBM AI services.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloudant
solution_components.role: Supports cloud-native data persistence in the solution's API and feedback workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the cloud components that integrate the semantic search and API services.

data_flow: Public-sector role descriptions entered into the RiVa portal are converted to embeddings with watsonx.ai, searched semantically in watsonx.data and Milvus, filtered by public-administration criteria, and returned through RiVa as suggested profiles, activities, and future skill recommendations.
business_outcome: Formez PA expects to reduce manual profile management work, improve search accuracy, and make professional-role data more consistent and usable across public administrations.
metrics: 90% expected reduction in time spent on data entry and processing tasks
architecture_clues: The solution uses semantic similarity rather than exact keyword matching.
A microservice intermediary converts requests into embeddings and invokes vector search APIs.
User feedback is built into the product to refine results over time.
